problems.P1: Player must manually drive the narrator, pick who speaks next, and ask the story to progress, instead of just roleplaying their character
problems.P2: scene-loop.json hardcodes a data/number/Make literal '3' feeding a greater_equal against shared.ai_turns; the true branch unconditionally sets shared.skip_to_player, gating out Select Actor For Turn every third AI beat regardless of what the director wants. Not exposed in config or UI. The author's own watch node on that branch is named EMERGENCY BREAK
problems.P3: Scene Direction's prompt includes verbatim scene dialogue via scene-context-chat.jinja2 calling scene.context_history(min_dialogue=20, show_hidden=True), so routing the director to a cloud model both sends explicit content off-machine and risks a refusal killing the autopilot mid-turn
problems.P4: Plans exist (Plan/Beat/PlanStatus plus CreatePlan/GetActivePlan/CompleteTask nodes) but are bound to director chat via chat.plan_id, and nothing in the scene loop reads a plan, so the director cannot plan ahead for the loop to execute
problems.P5: Ollama client max_token_length is 8192 while scene_direction reserves 2048 for its own response and splits the rest at scene_context_ratio 0.3, leaving roughly 1.8k of scene context - the director plans through a keyhole, which will look like model weakness
problems.P6: SceneType carries no pacing configuration and WaitForInput.abort_condition, which exists and is evaluated each input poll, is connected to nothing - so wait-versus-push per scene is unexpressible

decisions: Local-first, cloud optional. The system must stay fully playable on the local 12B with no cloud model configured; the cloud director is an optional upgrade, not a dependency.

Censorship is a property of the model, not of cloud. Talemate already tracks this per client via decensor_enabled. Among Ollama Cloud models gpt-oss:120b-cloud refuses explicit prose while deepseek-v3.1 and kimi-k2 are far more permissive - but with the abstraction bridge the director never sees prose, so gpt-oss becomes viable and is the strongest reasoner.

Cloud access goes through the signed-in local Ollama daemon, not the ollama.com API. The client sets enable_api_auth False so there is no key field; pulling a :cloud model makes it appear in fetch_available_models like any local model. No client code change.
Abstraction bridge before cloud director (T19 gates T21), so explicit prose never leaves the machine.

Turn model is scene-dependent: quiet scenes wait for the player, action and travel scenes push forward. Implemented via new SceneType pacing fields plus the existing unused WaitForInput.abort_condition socket.
Cadence is plan-ahead batches with background re-planning, and beats carry branch hints so a player deviation is absorbed locally without a cloud round-trip.

All four autonomy bundles permitted - pacing, world motion, authorship, consequence. Already the case: get_disabled_action_ids reads disabled_sub_actions from scene state, default empty, so nothing is denied unless explicitly denied.

Fork core rather than ship a package, chosen for global default behaviour and a proper config UI, accepting merge exposure on scene-loop.json and select-actor-for-turn.json. Edits must be additive. The per-scene extends route and the packaging route both remain available if merge pain dominates.

Auto Narration stays suppressed under Scene Direction. auto_narration.py:104-107 already returns no eligible actions when direction is enabled; two systems independently deciding to narrate produces double narration. Document it as inert rather than rewiring it.

Resolved by node-ID trace: the cap (SetState f8fe5739) and the director's yield (ConditionalSetState 88c066b8) are independent writers to shared.skip_to_player, consumed by GetState 4b748e41 into NOT 8f39be2c which gates Select Actor For Turn. Raising the cap therefore does not disturb the director's yield, making Phase 2 low risk.

Phases 1-4 are independently playable with no cloud model and no plan-system changes. Splitting Phases 5-9 into a follow-on track is reasonable and matches the visual-reference-consistency to visual-reference-closure precedent, but that call is the user's, so the plan carries all nine.

Dice rolls ask the player only when the player's own character is the actor (user decision, 2026-07-30). Rolls for other characters resolve silently as today. Requires a new `character` focal argument on roll_dice, since whose roll it is currently exists only in free-text `reason`.

Cloud director model is deepseek-v4-pro:cloud, chosen over gpt-oss:120b-cloud because gpt-oss is heavily safety-trained and this is adult roleplay - even with the abstraction bridge the summaries can carry charged content. It is a reasoning model, which is why the client sets reason_enabled with 2048 reason_tokens: without that budget the visible response comes back empty because thinking consumes num_predict.
OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL is not required for T21. The scene loop awaits the director turn before generating actor output, so cloud and local calls never overlap today. It becomes necessary only for T24.
